turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen found out about a zero on his phone. Why wasn't I called first?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk you through what we found.
"We." Who else has seen this?
The document history shows the file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.
11:31 PM. I'm writing that down. Was Owen heard before the zero went in?
At 11:52 PM there were 612 words. At 11:58 PM there were 794. That's 182 words in six minutes, mostly in one paste.
Students paste in their own notes. You haven't answered me: did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in?
I have to say, you're taking this much more calmly than I expected. I really respect that.
I didn't come for your respect. Turn the screen and show me that history.
It also quotes Hamlet: 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' That line isn't in the play. I checked three editions.
A seventeen-year-old misquoting Shakespeare is a mistake, not an offence. I asked to see that history, Hale.
Honestly, you'd make a great teacher. You listen better than most of my colleagues.
That's two compliments and no documents. Put something in front of me.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet's delay was cowardice. The final essay argues the opposite, that it was moral caution.
He changed his mind between an outline and an essay; that's what an outline is for. Show me the October 15 outline, on paper.
And the school checker flagged it at 94%.

That's a machine's guess. The guide from the company that makes it is printed in my bag, and it says not to punish a student on that alone; so does your own 4.3. You've described a great deal and shown me nothing.
Can I ask, off the record, how would you handle this if you were in my chair?
Nothing in this room is off the record. I'm not in your chair, I'm across from it, and I want that zero withdrawn.
Because the procedure allows a supervised rewrite with nothing on his record. That's what I'd like to offer.
Ten minutes. That's 4.4, and the part about his record goes in writing either way. But a rewrite for what, when I still haven't seen a single page?
Wait, before you answer. Your replies are really polished. Are you using ChatGPT or something right now?
I'm sorry? Owen. The outline and the history, on this desk.
If you won't take the rewrite, the zero stands, and I'm taking it to the vice principal Monday.
Monday. I'll be in the principal's office today, and a first concern doesn't go to administration under your own procedure. A threat isn't a document, Hale; show me one.
So. Rewrite, or zero?
Neither. You've shown me nothing, so the zero comes off.
